title: Cache repeated structural validation with bounded verified-content reuse
summary: Reduce repeated immutable snapshot validation without caching authorization, revocation, currentness or dependency decisions. Ship separately after the dev16 freeze.
in_scope: Cache successful checks by locally recomputed content digest plus exact bytes, schema version and validator/registry identity; bound process memory and return detached decoded values.
Retain strict canonical input, stored-row integrity, current head, access, revocation, dependency and capture guards.
Measure the unchanged consumer prototype without cProfile, cold and warm before/after; record the environments, phase times and workload limitations in a later SDK build.
out_of_scope: Frozen monitoring 1.0/1.1 wire changes, provider calls or qualification, StateCivics implementation and deployment.
implementation: Cache successful checks by locally recomputed content digest plus exact bytes, schema version and validator/registry identity; bound process memory and return detached decoded values.
Retain strict canonical input, stored-row integrity, current head, access, revocation, dependency and capture guards.
Measure the unchanged consumer prototype without cProfile, cold and warm before/after; record the environments, phase times and workload limitations in a later SDK build.

acceptance.criterion: Repeated identical valid content avoids redundant schema work without accepting changed content.
acceptance.verification: Exercise mutation, same-ID changed content, invalid/floating types, hash collision, validator/schema separation and bounded eviction.

acceptance.criterion: Storage integrity and live authorization remain enforced after warming.
acceptance.verification: Warm a valid row then alter bytes with its old digest and require E_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE; run existing revocation, currentness, expiry and control checks.

acceptance.criterion: A separate SDK retains frozen wires and has measured runtime results.
acceptance.verification: Compare unprofiled cold/warm consumer prototype and behavior, installed wheel checks and 1.0/1.1 lock inventories; report actual timings, not inferred profiler speedup.

tests: Exercise mutation, same-ID changed content, invalid/floating types, hash collision, validator/schema separation and bounded eviction.
Warm a valid row then alter bytes with its old digest and require E_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE; run existing revocation, currentness, expiry and control checks.
Compare unprofiled cold/warm consumer prototype and behavior, installed wheel checks and 1.0/1.1 lock inventories; report actual timings, not inferred profiler speedup.
risks: Structural validity does not confer freshness, authority, integrity or delivery success.

reuse.application: Reuse existing validators and native milestone consumer; no replacement storage or admission engine.
